source_row.rationale: CDC recommends comprehensive water management programs for healthcare facilities because complex building water systems can support Legionella growth and transmission and healthcare facilities serve vulnerable populations. Water management therefore includes internal plumbing and relevant devices, not only outdoor water features.
source_row.source_detail: March 15, 2024: healthcare facilities should develop and implement comprehensive water management programs to reduce Legionella growth and transmission; building water systems and vulnerable populations are central risk considerations.
source_row.source_name: CDC — Water Management in Healthcare Facilities
source_row.stem: Why does a hospital need a water management program that includes the building's internal plumbing rather than focusing only on outdoor fountains or cooling towers?
